statement: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud provider backed by NVIDIA, raised about $1 billion of private short-dated debt arranged by JP Morgan Chase to buy NVIDIA GPUs that will be leased by Microsoft, following a $1 billion secured credit facility closed in May 2026 and a $926 million senior secured term loan B facility for NVIDIA GB300 GPUs announced the week of 2026-08-24.
why: Private credit is still funding GPU purchases for non-hyperscaler buyers, and the short-dated structure implies lenders expect the chips to generate cash fast enough to repay quickly.

impact.mechanism: Available debt at the marginal buyer converts into GPU orders; a Microsoft lease behind the assets shortens the path from purchase to revenue and keeps credit open.

evidence.excerpt: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia Corp., has raised about $1 billion of private short-dated debt for computing chips tied to its collaboration with Microsoft Corp.
announced the closing of a $926 million senior secured term loan B facility for Nvidia GB300 GPUs.

confidence.basis: Secondary source only: TechCrunch republishing Bloomberg reporting. The document states the Bloomberg original returned HTTP 403 and that no Lambda press release confirming the financing was found as of 2026-08-30.
